headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of July 30, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 16.48% compared to SPY's 9.46%. This 7.01% alpha indicates that the portfolios are not only generating positive returns but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 43.82%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 50', still managed a respectable return of 10.58%. This relative strength against SPY is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, providing a useful signal of resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
